basics.name: Anupam Chugh
basics.label: iOS & macOS engineer
basics.summary: iOS & macOS engineer. Eleven years building apps, starting with Android tutorials at JournalDev, and two and a half editing other engineers as managing editor of Better Programming. Since 2024 I ship small Apple apps to the App Store.

work.name: Independent
work.summary: Small Apple apps, each from one human moment. Rifflet, Orbits and EchoHunt are on the App Store.

work.name: Better Programming
work.summary: Took over from Zack Shapiro in 2021 and ran it until September 2023; it has been on hiatus since I left. Read thousands of submissions a month with a small editor team. Started Coffee Bytes, a Medium newsletter that put other writers in front of readers: weekly picks, roundups, author interviews, and a list of writers from age 10 to a septuagenarian learning Java. Over its life the publication carried 4.6K authors, 16.8K stories and 151M views, and paid writers close to $1M.

work.name: Agricx
work.summary: Led the Android team and planned work with the web and ML teams. Built the company’s first iOS app alone: a camera that grades crops on the device with OpenCV and AVFoundation.

work.name: MOBEY (Gold Coast, Australia)
work.summary: Built MOBEY’s alcohol-delivery apps, customer and driver, from nothing on Android, and redesigned their iOS apps in 2017. Featured on 7 News Brisbane.

work.name: JournalDev
work.summary: Taught myself Android by writing it up as I learned: 300+ tutorials on Android, Java, Kotlin and Swift. Built JournalDev’s first Android app from scratch; the site was later acquired by DigitalOcean.

projects.name: Glint
projects.description: Read-only market research for Indian F&O and crypto on iPhone and Mac, in development. Ask in plain language and it answers with charts, scans and option chains from its own market data. It never places an order.

projects.name: Pastport
projects.description: On-device Safari history intelligence for macOS: movements, bookings, threads, and grounded local answers.

projects.name: iowncode
projects.description: Curated open-source Apple and Android sample projects with 900+ stars across Computer Vision, Core ML, and SwiftUI.

projects.name: VisionCreditScan & Swipeless Tinder
projects.description: Open-source Apple Vision prototypes demonstrating real-time card OCR and touchless hand-pose gesture navigation.

projects.name: Coffee Bytes
projects.description: A Medium newsletter (2022–2023) that featured other writers' work: weekly picks, hand-picked roundups, author interviews, and “It's never too late or early to start something”.
